title: Reject leader's red-completion offer
description: Reject leader's red-completion offer. Reject because the current leader gets red for too little cash. The decision turns on monopoly timing and opponent threat, not printed property price.

final_action.public_message: I’m willing to trade St James Place for $200 and Illinois Avenue. Let me know if that works.
final_action.private_thought: St James Place is orange; I need better value. I already own Kentucky, so the offered Kentucky is useless. I want cash and a red property to complete a monopoly with my Indiana and Kentucky. Propose $200 + Illinois Avenue.
